source: Avalanche Sephiroth, an optional outfit for the playable Sephiroth (Create a Character System 3.6): PC0010_12_Avalanche_Sephiroth_Transformed (Sephiroth in the Avalanche clothes, with the transformed Sephiroth's wing) on its own skeleton PC0010_11_Skeleton, which is Sephiroth's PC0010_00_Skeleton (the same 1061 bones, parents and rest pose) with 187 more for the clothes (jacket, hood, collar, belt, more hair: its cloth physics moves them). The skeleton joins Sephiroth's skeleton family, so the outfit plays all of his animations and every form's. The wing is the material slot PC0010_10_Wing, the forms' part: hidden in NORMAL, shown in WINGED, FLYING and KH2, fading in and out as on his own model; BIZARRO and SAFER put on their own models and come back to the outfit. Goes with AvalancheSephirothOutfit_P (the outfit and his blueprint wearing it), FullyPlayableSephirothDataAssets_P and SephirothForms.json; without AvalancheSephirothOutfit_P this file does nothing and he wears his own model.
